description: This file defines an interface for a simple protective configuration mechanism, including functions for encrypting, decrypting, and managing secrets. It provides a simplified API for secure storage and retrieval of sensitive data, with functions to get and destroy secrets, and to perform encryption/decryption. The file primarily contains function declarations, macros, and documentation comments, and it is intended to be included in C projects that require such security features.

methods.name: simpleProtectConfigData
methods.description: Encrypts data and returns a BASE64 encoded string for storage, requires a namespace for key management.

methods.name: simpleUnprotectConfigData
methods.description: Decrypts protected data and returns the original string, requires a namespace.

methods.name: simpleProtectDecrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using a secret, returns plaintext string. Note: incorrect secrets may produce garbage.

methods.name: simpleProtectEncrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using a secret, returns encrypted string.

methods.name: simpleProtectGetSecret
methods.description: Loads or creates a secret key for a namespace; returns NULL on failure.

methods.name: simpleProtectDestroySecret
methods.description: Destroys and frees a secret key.

methods.name: simpleProtectDestroySecret__auto
methods.description: Scope-bound helper to automatically destroy a secret.
